dedupe_keys.name: floating wind kra england wales ni the crown estate

description: The Crown Estate publishes spatial outputs from Everoze’s October 2020 methodology for floating offshore wind key resource areas. Six technology groups describe anchoring and sea-state combinations using depth, Quaternary thickness and significant-wave-height criteria; the analysis uses an overall 9 m/s minimum wind speed. Technology availability is considered to 2040. Other seabed uses and environmental constraints are excluded from this initial screen, so these areas do not establish permission to build. Coverage is English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source offers data free of charge under Crown Estate GIS terms, with attribution, distribution and resale restrictions. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the other Crown Estate wind, tidal and wave agreement layers reviewed in the Thames Estuary catalogue.
